—CORSAIR iCUE METHOD—
K55 RGB: https://www.corsair.com/us/en/Categories/Products/Gaming-Keyboards/Standard-Gaming-Keyboards/K55-RGB-Gaming-Keyboard/p/CH-9206015-NA
Github: https://github.com/TaranVH/2nd-keyboard/tree/master/Corsair
Tutorial video: https://youtu.be/cQ2atofn3lE

—RAZER SYNAPSE METHOD—
Cyonosa Chroma: https://www.razer.com/gaming-keyboards-keypads/razer-cynosa-chroma
Github: https://github.com/TaranVH/2nd-keyboard/tree/master/Razer
Tutorial video: https://youtu.be/GttedCcyxa4

—HASU USB CONVERTER METHOD—
Converter: https://www.1upkeyboards.com/shop/controllers/usb-to-usb-converter/
K120: (But any cheap keyboard will work) https://www.logitech.com/en-ca/product/k120
Github: https://github.com/TaranVH/2nd-keyboard/tree/master/HASU_USB

If you wish to create your own .hex file, here is the video tutorial for that:
https://youtu.be/kTXK8kZaZ8c

—FOR THIS VIDEO—

If you want to use a .hex file I’ve already created for you, I recommend this one:
https://github.com/TaranVH/2nd-keyboard/blob/master/HASU_USB/F24/F24.hex

Download, install, and run QMK toolbox: https://qmk.fm/toolbox/

Use it to flash the .hex file onto your converter, as shown in this video.

If that doesn't work for you, try following this alternative guid for flashing your .hex file: https://github.com/mechmerlin/qmk_setup/blob/master/windows_flashing.md

Download the AutoHotKey installer: https://www.autohotkey.com/download/

Then, download this AutoHotkey script by clicking RAW, and CTRL S to save. (Delete the little .txt if it appears!)
https://github.com/TaranVH/2nd-keyboard/blob/master/HASU_USB/QMK_F24_macro_keyboard.ahk

Create this folder structure, and save it here:
C:\AHK\2nd-keyboard\HASU_USB\QMK_F24_macro_keyboard.ahk

Now, double-click on it to get it running. A friendly icon should appear in your taskbar. Boop!
Now, try typing into a text document. Instead of text, you should be seeing tooltips. Perfect! Now you can replace those with your own functions, and calls to those functions. It’s all normal AutoHotKey scripting from this point on.

TUTORIAL IF YOU ARE NEW TO AUTOHOTKEY:
https://autohotkey.com/docs/Tutorial.htm

—

VARIOUS LINKS:
Full list of all scan codes, virtual keys, and the key replacements/substitutions I made for modifier keys, etc: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1GSj0gKDxyWAecB3SIyEZ2ssPETZkkxn67gdIwL1zFUs/edit?usp=drive_web&ouid=107638578296445823789
Converting a Model M using a teensey: https://blog.lmorchard.com/2016/02/21/modelm-controller/

—

snippet.title: Cooler Master CM Storm Gaming, Cases & Coolers - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
CM Storm by Cooler Master might be the only "mainstream" company bringing the fight to Filco and Ducky when it comes to offering a WIDE variety of mechanical keyboards. They are even bringing a product to market with Cherry MX GREEN switches. They feel kinda like heavy blues. There's some other stuff too.

For cases and coolers, there is some innovative stuff coming including pre-filled liquid cooling and vapour chambers. They also have a TON of new case concepts.

Day 5 - video 2

snippet.description:
Antec & the sub-brand A.M.P. (Antec Mobile Products) had quite a few things on display. The most notable were the White P280 with a window, the value gaming case with a surprising price tag, and the variety of mobile accessories.

Day 5 - video 9

snippet.description:

Day 5 - video 7

snippet.title: NVIDIA Project Shield Hands On Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
Project Shield is NVIDIA's Android-based, Tegra-powered handheld gaming console with the unique ability to accept a low latency wireless video input stream from a GeForce equipped PC. That means it can run Android games that are installed on the device itself, or it can run Windows games by relying on the computer to do the heavy lifting processing the game!

Day 5 - video 4

snippet.title: Linksys New AC Router Products - EPIC Surprise at the End - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:

Day 5 - video 8

snippet.title: Swiftech H220 Showcase & REAL-WORLD Performance & Silence Demo Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:

Day 5 - video 5

snippet.description:

Day 5 - video 1

snippet.title: Ubuntu Phone Featuring Slick Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description: More options is rarely a bad thing for consumers, and there's a new game in town when it comes to mobile OS!

snippet.title: Sony Xperia Z 1080p Water Resistant Android Smartphone - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
The Xperia Z is one of the most impressive demos that we was at the show. Not only are the specs of it just plain awesome, but they had one running in a showcase that had a button to let you dunk it into the water while it was running!

Day 3 -  video 14

snippet.title: Sony 4K Camcorders - Everything from Entry Level to Pro - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
Sony was kind enough to tell us a little bit about the cameras that are going to enable everyone from travelling videographers to professional studios to shoot in 4K including a compact 4K model that no one seems to know much about.

Day 3 - video 13

snippet.title: Sony 4K 56" OLED TV Demo - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
OLED TV's are getting closer to being something you can actually buy, but this Sony TV won't be available on shelves for a while

Day 3 - video 12

snippet.title: Sony 4K vs 1080p Resolution Demo with 86" TVs - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
Sony put up a picture of newsprint side-by-side on their 4K and 1080p models of TVs to demonstrate the improved clarity that can be achieveed with 4K.

Day 3 - video 11

snippet.title: Slick's Highlights of the Samsung Booth - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
Slick covers the new professional display from Samsung that operates in portrait mode & some sweet headphones. Diesel also makes an appearance.

Day 3 - video 10

snippet.title: Samsung Galaxy Android Camera - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
The Galaxy Camera from Samsung comes pre-loaded with Android Jellybean and due to its custom software is capable of a lot of sweet functionality that you just wouldn't see with a normal camera including sophisticated "helpers" for non-camera people, and manual settings for shutterbugs.

Day 3 - video 9

snippet.title: Samsung SC77 Touch 60 Degree Tilting Touchscreen LCD Monitor - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
The SC77 Touch from Samsung should help with the ergonomics of using a touch screen on the desktop. It's multi-touch and it folds down to an angle where it won't be as fatiguing to use as a completely upright monitor.

Day 3 - video 8

snippet.title: ASUS MB168 Featherlight USB3 Notebook Screen Expansion - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description: This MB168 monitor weighs almost nothing, and the final version will be capable of auto-rotation and will have an ambient light sensor!

snippet.title: ASUS QUBE Google TV Device Showcase With Primetime - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description: The QUBE from ASUS is an Android device, and comes with a very awesome remote that has a trackpad, voice input, and a full keyboard on the back.

snippet.title: ASUS Orion Headset & Essence One Muses Edition Amp & DAC - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description: Slick's first shot at hosting one of our CES coverage segments. Make sure you tweet him @SlickPC to let him know how it went!

snippet.title: ASUS RAIDR Express PCIe Storage Device - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
We don't have many details about the RAIDR Express yet, but we are very exciting to see even more categories coming from ASUS as they do such a good job of everything they touch.

Day 2 - video 6

snippet.title: Corsair Obsidian 900D Ultimate Enthusiast Case Feat. George Makris - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
The Obsidian 900D has finally been unveiled. They have created the most flexible, over-the-top gaming & enthusiast chassis on the market.

Day 2 - video 16

snippet.title: ASUS Transformer AIO P1810 All-in-One PC & World's Biggest Tablet - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
The Transformer AIO P1810 runs both Windows 8 and Android! It has a full desktop computer inside it, then you can detach the screen and use it as an Android tablet. You can even use wifi to stream your windows desktop to it!

Day 2 - video 5

snippet.title: ASUS Tytan Republic of Gamers Desktops - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
The CG8480 is a high performance Ivy Bridge machine with a GTX 680. The CG8890 is the "over the top" RoG style desktop that will turn heads. Both machines feature an auto overclocking button, but the CG8890 also has motors inside that open up when you push the button!

Day 2 - video 12

snippet.title: ASUS Zenbook Touch Ultrabook & VariDrive Flexible Dock - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
The Zenbook touch is an upgrade to the existing Zenbook that adds multi-touch input without adding a significant amount of additional thickness or weight. 

The VariDrive is a life saver for road warriors, providing a USB3 hub, ethernet port, and an optical drive in one small compact package!

snippet.title: Corsair Vengeance M65 M95 K95 Peripheral Showcase - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
The new M65, M95, and K95 Corsair Vengeance peripherals bring a lot of things to the table that fans of Corsair have been asking for, they listened and delivered! More colours, higher sensitivity, and the most custom backlight ever!

Day 2 - video 14

snippet.title: ASUS G46VW 14" RoG Gaming Notebook - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
With the G46VW ASUS has taken a leadership position in the portable gaming space providing a GTX660M, a powerful processor, and dual drives in a 14" shell.

Day 2 - video 4

snippet.title: ASUS TX300 Transformer Book Tablet Windows 8 - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
The TX300 Transformer Book allows you to use it as a regular Windows 8 tablet, then attach it to a dock for more connections, extra battery life, and even an additional hard drive!

Day 2 - video 2

snippet.title: ASUS PCE AC66 and asus range extender  - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
Asus has delivered a strong and viable AC solution wrapped up in their AC66 package, The raw power of AC demands more than most solutions currently on the market, Asus took note of that and brought all their chips to the table with this beast.

Day 2 - video 13

snippet.title: ASUS Ares II Dual 7970 Video Card - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
ASUS has unleashed the Ares II, a dual 7970 GPU graphics card

Day 2 - video 7

snippet.title: ASUS Tai Chi 31 Notebook/Tablet Windows 8 - Linus Tech Tips CES 2013
snippet.description:
The Tai Chi 31 is a larger version of the existing Tai Chi 21. Both of them allow users to switch between notebook mode and tablet mode using a double sided screen!

Day 2 - video 1

snippet.title: How I Fixed my Sony Vegas Rendering Woes Easy 4GB Memory Patch Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description:
This has been plaguing me forever. I spent so much time sending tickets to Sony (most of which just received canned responses) and reading their support forum and whatnot without any kind of indication that this was the problem. Finally I just went with my gut feeling and tried to figure out if it was some kind of a RAM issue.

Turns out Sony Vegas 11 is STILL 32-bit only for the non-professional ($500+ version) so that's what's causing it to crap out all the time. 

Here's what I want to know: 

1. How did this ever make it past QC? I've had issues rendering anything longer than about 15 minutes before applying this patch

2. Why didn't Sony just patch the .EXE for me?

3. WHY ISN'T IT 64-BIT IN THIS DAY AND AGE?? And then we sit around wondering why PC users are moving to Mac!

snippet.description: This camera has the very unique features of having an LCD on the front as well as a touchscreen LCD on the back. The one on the front allows you to aim it at yourself for taking easy self-photos.

snippet.title: Falcon Dust Off Keyboard Wipes Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Maybe this is a bit of a random product first look, but it came up because I inherited a REALLY old REALLY dirty IBM "clicky" keyboard, and I'm trying to figure out how to get it to the point where I'd put it in my house, never mind actually type on it...

snippet.title: Acer Aspire 1410 Olympics Edition Notebook/Netbook Computer Unboxing Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Vancouver 2010! It's a big enough event that it merits its own line of notebooks and netbooks. I have a quick look at this thing, which honestly feels like a great showcase for how far Acer has come in the last 5 years. It's solidly built, slick looking, and I'm genuinely impressed!

snippet.title: nVidia Pick Your Poison Free Game Campaign for GTS 250 Video Cards Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description:
nVidia just launched their "Pick Your Poison" free game promotion. It allows anyone who buys a GTS 250 video card while supplies last to pick whether they want a copy of Street Fighter 4, Resident Evil 5, or Dark Void. Pretty cool stuff.

I also give away two codes in the video :)

snippet.title: Cooler Master Hyper 212 Plus Heatpipe HDT CPU Cooling Heatsink Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Having a look at a very popular heatsink from Cooler Master. The Hyper 212 Plus shares many features with more expensive heatsinks, but manages to do everything it does at a very competitive price, which obviously makes it very popular.

snippet.title: Powercolor Radeon HD 5450 DirectX 11 Video Card Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Having a look at ATI's most basic product featuring DirectX 11 support for Windows 7 & Windows Vista. The 5450 isn't going to break any extreme gaming records, but what it will do is provide better than onboard performance, while not breaking the bank.

snippet.title: Patriot Box Office Subscribe & Win! Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Subscribe to both my LinusTechTips and NCIXcom YouTube channels and our North American viewers can qualify to win a Patriot Box Office!

snippet.title: OCZ Vertex Turbo Indilinx SSD Solid State Drive Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Finally I take a quick look at the Vetex Turbo. Surprise surprise. It looks basically the same as the other OCZ SSD drives, but the key difference is under the hood. The Turbo  series features an overclocked Indilinx controller for better performance.

snippet.title: Seasonic X-Series 650W 80+ Gold Certified PC Power Supply Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Today I'll be having a look at an 80+ Gold power supply. Basically this is a super efficient, but low wattage power supply. For most computers this is the most efficient configuration because at about 50-60% load, this PSU can provide 90% efficiency and very low noise levels and most computers do not draw more than about 250-325W under load.

snippet.title: ASUS Maximus III Gene P55 mATX SLI Motherboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Sometimes big things do come in small packages! This miniature member of the ASUS RoG (Republic of Gamers) line of products brings almost all of the features of its big siblings to the table, but it uses a micro ATX form factor to do it rather than a full sized ATX one!

snippet.title: Antec Truepower Quattro 1200W Power Supply Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: This PSU has some unique features, which is rare for a power supply. Mostly it's just a mix of the usual "efficiency this" and "regulation that", but you should definitely check out the video for this one!

snippet.title: G.Skill F3-12800CL9T-6GBNQ 6GB Triple Channel DDR3 RAM Kit Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Just having a quick look at some G.Skill memory. With its striking red heatspreaders, this value oriented memory is sure to be a crowd-pleaser!

snippet.title: ASUS Xonar Essence ST Audiophile Stereo PCI Sound Card Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: This is a very unique product. So unique that I actually wasn't really sure of the best way to present it. Partly because I'm not big into the audiophile scene, but also because it's so different from anything else out there. Basically if you don't already know you want one, you don't need to know about this product.

snippet.title: ASUS P6T7 WS Workstation X58 Core i7 SLI Crossfire Motherboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: While not a part of their "Republic of Gamers" branding, this is a very high end, very premium board from ASUS that delivers a lot of cool features including 7 PCIe 16x slots for running up to 7 single slot graphics cards! Great for a folding monster!

snippet.title: ASUS P6T SE X58 Core i7 LGA1366 DDR3 Motherboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Very good "value" performance board. I say "value" because it's still quite expensive, but you usually get some awesome performance and features for your money with ASUS SE series boards. The P6T SE is no exception!

snippet.title: LG BH10LS30 Super Multi Blu Blu-Ray & DVD Drive Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Meant as a look at a retail box optical drive more than anything else. It's in contrast to my recent unboxing of the Samsung OEM drive.

snippet.title: SilenX iXtrema Pro 120mm LED Computer Case Cooling Fan Unboxing & First Look
snippet.description: This is meant to be a look at SilenX fans in general and is not supposed to be specific to the colour of the one I'm looking at in the video.

snippet.title: Silverstone Nightjar 450W Fanless Silent Computer Power Supply Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Silverstone released this ages, but it's my first time seeing one in person. It weighs a TON. I could barely hold it up with one hand while gesturing at it with the other. I guess it's all the heatsinks to keep this baby cool!

snippet.title: OCZ ModXStream Pro 700W Modular Computer Power Supply Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: This is a VERY popular power supply, and I think a big part of it is that it's the best value for an inexpensive, reasonably efficient modular power supply, so obviously many users will be interested in something like this.

snippet.title: Gigabyte GeForce GT 210 Mainstream Graphics Card With HDMI Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: The big feature of this card appears to be that it has a gold plated HDMI connector. View the video for more about gold plating and HDMI connectors...

snippet.title: Intel Core i3 530 LGA1156 Dual Core Processor Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Having a look at a slightly slower version of the Core i3 540 that I already unboxed :p

snippet.title: Samsung OEM DVD Writer & CD-RW Combo Drive Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: This video is mostly just so I can put it on the product pages on NCIX and demonstrate easily to customers what comes with an OEM DVD drive.

snippet.title: Kingston ValueRAM 2GB 240pin DDR2 Low Profile RAM Module Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: This is potentially the most boring unboxing ever. I was just wandering around in the warehouse and I saw this thing and I was like "oh that's cool", but then it wasn't.

snippet.title: eVGA GTX 275 Co-op PhysX Edition w/ GTS 250 Built-In Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: This is a VERY unique product. I guess I kinda expect this sort of thing from ASUS or Zotac, but not from eVGA. It's a GTX 275 with a GTS 250 glued on for PhysX support. Very cool.

snippet.title: MSI NF750-G55 AM3 DDR3 SLI Motherboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: This is a fairly unique board in that it's one of the least expensive SLI ready boards on the market and provides most of the features and capabilities of higher end boards at a fraction of the cost

snippet.title: Corsair Dominator Airflow RAM Fan Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: This is for keeping your memory nice and cool, especially when overclocking. There was an old one that I didn't like very much, but this one looks much better!

snippet.title: XFX Radeon HD 5670 512MB DirectX 11 Eyefinity Video Card Unboxing & First Look
snippet.description: ATI seems determined to have a top-to-bottom DX11 lineup ready before nVidia releases a single DirectX 11 card, and here's yet another card in that ~$100 price bracket that fills in a performance/price gap in the current product mix fairly nicely. This isn't REALLY a gaming card, but it does have a little bit of oomph, especially compared to any low end or onboard solution, and it does have the full 5000 series feature set including 7.1 audio via HDMI, eyefinity, and DirectX 11 of course!

snippet.title: NZXT Hades Mid-Tower ATX Gaming Computer Case Unboxing & First Look
snippet.description: The NZXT Hades is actually a fairly interesting product. I guess that's why they dropped one on my doorstep for me to have a look at. I apologize for this being such a long unboxing, but it's hard to really demonstrate a case well without taking a while. Also I'm not too good at case unboxings since I haven't done many, so I got a little lost in the middle of it and started to ramble. Oh well.

snippet.title: Gigabyte H55M-USB3 H55 Core i3 LGA1156 mATX Motherboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Gigabyte's come out in full force with H55 boards, and this is one of their highest end ones. It features (you guessed it) USB 3.0, which means that you can get 10x the data rate of a conventional USB 2.0 connection, which means much faster connections to your data and devices!

snippet.title: Steelseries 7G Mechanical Key Switch Gaming Keyboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: The 7G has been a staple for professional gamers for a long time, but that doesn't prevent me from taking a "first look" at it. It's not a real first look, mind you, because I've used this keyboard extensively in the past (and I love it), but it's a first look for you all, so I'll go ahead and call it that.

snippet.title: Palit GeForce GTX 260 Sonic 896MB DirectX 10 Video Card Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Today I look at a video card that isn't really new, but it's still got an interesting story behind it. Palit is back in North America for one thing, and for another they've brought their innovative designs in full force. This is a very unique looking GTX 260 compared to the others that are available in the US and Canadian markets right now.

snippet.title: Antec Truepower New 650W Modular Computer Power Supply Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: The Truepower New series of PSUs has been out for a while, but they have some features that are actually kind of unique compared to the rest of the Antec line up. First of all, unlike the PSUs above or below them, they have 120mm fans for cooling, whereas the rest use 80mm fans.

snippet.title: OCZ OCZACSSDBRKT2 2.5" to 3.5" Converter Drive Bay Adapter Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: This is a cool product. Well not really. I grabbed one because I need it to mount an SSD in a hot swap bay. It's a useful product though, I'll give it that.

snippet.title: NZXT IU01 USB Header Expander Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: This is a very cool product. It's so cool that I'm just going to make you watch the video to find out what it does!

snippet.title: ASUS P7H55-M Pro Core i3 & i5 H55 Motherboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Another H55 board. Honestly there's nothing particularly glamorous about looking at these H55 boards, but it's great to know that there's finally a value option out there that nets you performance that's almost equal to the older i5 and i7 CPUs in 2-threaded applications.

snippet.title: Tritton AX51 Pro 5.1 Surround Gaming Headset Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Today I have a look at a product category that I've never really touched on before. 5.1 surround gaming headphones. I've tried gaming with 5.1 speakers, and I've tried gaming with stereo headphones, but I've never tried a product from this strange "crossover" category.

snippet.title: BFG GS 550W Power Supply Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Just having a quick look at a power supply that's been a great value over the last few months and many of our users have been very happy with. There's nothing particularly stand-out about it except that it offers a stunning value and excellent quality in that we've seen almost none of them back!

snippet.title: Intel Core i3 540 CPU LGA1156 Dual Core Processor Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: What's special about this CPU is that it's a dual core, but the performance of each individual core is very similar to the "old" Core i5 quad cores and Core i7 quad cores. The Core i3 and Core i5 dual cores also feature high clock speeds for great performance in single threaded or dual threaded applications. Don't forget these CPUs have onboard video now too!!

snippet.title: OCZ Agility SSD 30GB Solid State Drive Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Having a look at the Agility SSD drive from OCZ. The biggest difference between the Agility series and the Vertex series is the sustained read/write performance. If you watched the video you'd know that... And all of the other stuff that I say in the video! :p

snippet.title: Gigabyte H55M-S2H H55 Core i3 LGA1156 DDR3 Motherboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Having a look at my first H55 board. This is quite a basic one and cuts off a lot of the "unnecessary" features, but even some that I would consider necessary like 4 DIMM slots. That's the price you pay with a basic board, but despite lacking in features, this H55 board has all of the performance of its big brother.

snippet.title: Powercolor Radeon HD 5750 1GB DirectX 11 Video Card Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Another piece of my mum's new PC. I went with this card because the performance per dollar is quite respectable (although not quite as good as the last generation high end cards like the 4850), and it has the latest feature set. That means that it's got DX11, and it also supports stuff like 7.1 audio over HDMI, meaning I can move it to their media center when it gets too slow for Sims X.

snippet.title: Intel X25-V 40GB SSD Solid State Hard Drive Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Today I have a look at the Intel X25-V. This is a very interesting drive because while it sacrifices a lot of the sequential read/write performance of the X25-M, it actually uses the same controller, so the random read/write performance is nearly identical. Since that's what makes most of the difference in real world performance, this drive should be a GREAT performer for the dollar.

snippet.title: OCZ StealthXStream 500W Quiet Power Supply Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: I know it's another OCZ power supply unboxing right on the heels of the last one, but that just happens to be what I have on hand at the moment. This one is for my mum's new PC. She's been doing a lot of work at home and her laptop can't do it anymore, so I put together a nice little machine for her and I thought this 500W SXS would be a great addition to it

snippet.title: OCZ Z-Series 850W 80+ Gold Power Supply Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Got an opportunity to take a look at a new addition to the Z-Series from OCZ. This is just like the other Z-Series units in that it's very efficient, but it looks to cut costs for users who don't care about a modular interface. Good value to be had here :)

snippet.title: EK Supreme HF Extreme Performance CPU Water Block  Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Yet another water cooling unboxing. EK is giving me an opportunity to have a look at their new version of the Supreme: The Supreme HF. HF stands for high flow and as far as I can tell it also stands for "shiny and sexy" because this thing looks AWESOME!

snippet.title: CES 2010 OCZ Suite SSD Tour Including Z-Drive P88 Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: While I was at CES I had a chance to visit the OCZ suite and check out all of their cool SSD products including the classic Vertex, Aglity, and Colossus products as well as some really cool new stuff including Vertex 2, Solid 2, and the Z-Drive P88!

snippet.title: Microsoft Reclusa Gaming Keyboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Having a quick look at the "powered by Razer" Microsoft Reclusa gaming keyboard. I had a look at the X6 recently, and while it's hard to say which I like more, the Reclusa does have some cool features.

snippet.title: D-Link DGL-4500 Gamer Lounge Wireless N Gigabit Gaming Router Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Having a quick look at a router that I've been using for the past 6+ months that I've been very happy with. It's a solid product and offers some (software) features that make it a small improvement over its DIR-655 cousin which I have also had the pleasure of using. Both very solid products.

snippet.title: Logisys Dual 12" Cold Cathodes for PC Lighting Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: These are a must-have for any casual/series modding project. CCFLs remain one of the most inexpensive and effective ways to light up a PC or PC enclosure.

snippet.title: BenQ Joybee GP1 "Almost Pocket" LED Projector Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: This thing is pretty cool. I don't actually get to unbox it since it was open already when I got the sample, but I do get to test it out and demo some of the neat features of this tiny, COOL projector.

snippet.title: e-Flight Blade MSR RC Micro Indoor Helicopter Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Well I splurged. Spent some money after Christmas and grabbed a Blade MSR. It's supposed to be the bee's knees, and it's compatible with my transmitter, so I figured what the hey.

snippet.title: Logitech G9x Laser Gaming Mouse Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: The G9 is a mouse that holds a special place in my heart. I've had one since launch and I love everything about it from the ergonomics, to the way it tracks on anything, to the way you can customize the colours of the indicator lights that tell you how high your sensitivity is. Today we have a quick look at the G9x, the successor to the G9.

snippet.title: Mod Smart UV & Glow in the Dark SATA Cables Unboxing (sorta) & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Too many people ignore SATA cables when they are doing a PC build with aesthetics in mind, and I'm just taking some time to show off some of the cool SATA cables that are out there.

snippet.title: Robot Chicken 2010 Calendar First Look & Unboxing Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Welcoming the new year, I'm having a look at a calendar that was purchased by one of my co-workers for this new year. Happy holidays everyone!!

snippet.title: Cooler Master V8 Heatpipe CPU Heatsink Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Cooler Master has been perennial contender for the "top dawg" award in CPU heatsinks for as long as I can remember. The V8 is another "by request" unboxing, and I have to confess I know nothing about its performance, but I'm very impressed by the overall fit & finish of this unit, as well as the appearance. Cooler Master really put those finishing touches on it to set it apart from the crowd.

snippet.title: Microsoft Sidewinder X6 Gaming Keyboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: The X6 has some pretty unique features including the way it handles macros, the way you can detach the number pad and put it on the right if you're a south paw, and the way it lights up the WASD keys (oh wait, that one's not that unique). But seriously this keyboard looks really good, and for the price it's a unique value in the market.

snippet.title: G.Skill Falcon II SSD Solid State Drive Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Much like the other Indilinx based SSDs out there, the G.Skill Falcon II series drives are top performers and a great value compared to the other solutions on the market.

snippet.title: ASUS P7P55D-E Deluxe P55 Core i5 Motherboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Today I have a look at another part of ASUS' new P55 lineup featuring USB 3.0 and SATA 6Gb/s. This is a fully featured board including 16+3 phase power (which somehow equals 24 phase power) as well as support for SLI and Crossfire.

snippet.title: Gigabyte 790FXTA-UD5 Premium AM3 Crossfire DDR3 Motherboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Here it is! As requested, I've finally started unboxing some of the new AMD boards that feature USB 3.0 and SATA 6Gb/s. This is Gigabyte's flagship AM3 board right now and it comes with all of the bells and whistles. Sorry the video is a bit long, but there's a lot to cover.

snippet.title: ASUS Crosslink File & Drive Sharing USB Cable Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: This product comes along at kinda a weird time given that it works based on the USB 2.0 standard rather than the newer, faster, better USB 3.0 standard, but that doesn't make it any less interesting. I've always found it very frustrating that you can't simply plug your laptop into your desktop via USB and just drag and drop files between them, but now you can! You can also share an optical drive which could be a HUGE boon for netbook users who only use an optical drive to install software once in a blue moon.

snippet.title: Razer Imperator High Performance Ergonomic Laser Gaming Mouse Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Today I have a look at a bit of an unusual product from Razer. Normally they go for more of a claw-grip style of mouse with an ambidextrous design, but we're seeing a bit more of a deviation from that tried and true formula with products like the Mamba and now the Imperator. This is a palm style, right handed ergonomic mouse that feels very comfortable even when compared to the Ikari Laser (imo the king of ergo mice)

snippet.title: Noctua NH-P14 FLX 140mm Silent Computer Cooling Fan Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: This fan is silent AND deadly. It's a 140mm fan that fits into a 120mm mounting spot. That means that you get to spin at even lower RPM than traditional 120mm fans, move a ton of air, and you don't have to get a new case that supports 140mm fans!

snippet.title: Toblerone Chocolate Bar Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Today I'll be unboxing a delicious chocolate treat. Thanks Santa!

snippet.title: Corsair Flash Voyager USB Thumb Drive Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Today I do a quick unboxing of the Corsair Flash Voyager USB thumb drive. It falls somewhere in the middle of the pack in terms of read and write speeds, but the main marketing bullet point is that it's extremely rugged and durable. Obviously it's not quite as indestructible as the Survivor but it still holds its own.

snippet.title: ASUS Crosshair III Formula AM3 DDR3 790FX Crossfire Motherboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Today I'm having a quick look at the Crosshair III Formula, which is arguably the most "premium" AM3 board out there since it's the top of the range "Republic of Gamers" board from ASUS.

snippet.title: BlueAnt S1 Bluetooth Handsfree Car Kit Setup Video Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Thought I'd do a quick video on how to actually pair the BlueAnt S1 to your phone. It takes only a couple of minutes and it's quite easy to do.

snippet.title: BlueAnt S1 Visor Mounted Handsfree Bluetooth Car Kit Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Today I have a quick look at the BlueAnt S1, which is a very popular handsfree car kit right now. With the laws changing here in Vancouver about driving with a cell phone, these are becoming very popular very fast.

snippet.title: Razer Abyssus Optical Gaming Mouse Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: The Abyssus is one of a couple of new Razer mice that I will be unboxing. It's an ambidextrous mouse with a focus on "no-nonsense" performance oriented design without frills & gimmicks.

snippet.title: ASUS O!Play Air Network 1080p Wireless HD Media Player Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: The most obvious improvements made over the original O!Play are the wireless networking functionality as well as the built in card reader. Overall I would expect the O!Play Air to be very successful simply based on how popular the original O!Play was.

snippet.title: Netgear GS608 Gigabit Green 8 Port Desktop Switch Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Today I have a quick look at a great switch that I'm already using at home. I had such good results with mine (bought it some time ago) I thought I'd better do a quick video about it. Very reliable and inexpensive little switch :)

snippet.title: Edifier e3300 Lifestyle 2.1 Speaker System Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips feat. Esther!
snippet.description: This is my Christmas present for Esther this year, so I thought it's only appropriate to demand not only that she allow me to unbox it on YouTube, but also that she make an appearance for her adoring Facebook fans.

snippet.title: Steelseries 5L Gaming Mouse Pad Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: This mouse pad actually really impressed me. I've been using it for a few days as of uploading this video and it's definitely a worthy replacement for my trusty QCK . Bravo Steelseries. It's a little bit faster than what I'm used to, but the comfort that I love from cloth is still there!

snippet.title: Steelseries 4H PC Gaming Headset Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Today I take a quick look at the Steelseries 4H headset. This is one of the more basic products in their lineup, but besides the "features" like detachable ear pieces, it's not very much unlike the 5H V2, but at a very competitive price.

snippet.title: ASUS P7P55D-E Pro P55 Core i5 LGA1156 Motherboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: I've finally gotten around to taking a quick look at one of ASUS' new P55 boards with USB 3.0 and SATA 6.0Gb/s. Basically not a whole lot has been updated except for those two MAJOR updates to the spec of this board. You can save yourself the trouble of watching if you already know what a USB 3.0 or SATA 6.0Gb/s port looks like.

snippet.title: Logitech G13 Gaming Keypad or Keyboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: This is a product that was a long time coming. A replacement for the traditional keyboard we've been using for gaming since the days of Wolfenstein (yeah I know there was stuff before that, but that's as far back as I go). Belkin tried, and their product is well-regarded, but it's about time one of the big boys took a shot at this one.

snippet.title: Antec Easy SATA Hot Swap Hard Drive Bay Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description:
Having a look at a very cool product from Antec. This nifty expansion bay slot will turn an ordinary (probably empty) 5.25" bay into a hot swap 3.5" bay! WOW!

Did I mention it's cheap?

snippet.title: A Quick Warning About the Dangers of Static Electricity & Computer Hardware Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description:
It struck me today that static electricity can be a real problem, and many users may not know the proper procedure for discharging any built up static electricity from their bodies so I got all charged up and made a video about it.

Epic fail puns here, but whatever.

snippet.title: Arctic Cooling MX-3 Thermal Compound Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description:
Who doesn't like thermal compound? If you raised your hand, then you suck! Just kidding...

Not sure where I was going with that.

snippet.title: Microsoft Sidewinder X8 Cordless Gaming Mouse Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: I've been interested in seeing this mouse since I first heard of it. It boasts excellent wireless 2.4GHz performance, along with a host of other gaming related features.

snippet.title: Razer Lycosa Mirror Gaming Keyboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Today I have a look at a pretty cool special edition of the Razer Lycosa keyboard. It features quiet keys, a very standard (read: good) layout and some other key gaming related features.

snippet.title: Primochill Typhoon III Water Cooling Reservoir and Pump Top Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Another completely self-indulgent unboxing of water cooling stuff! The Typhoon III is a very unique reservoir, so you should check this out whether you care about water cooling or not. Also I edited a video for the first time.

snippet.title: Gigabyte P55A-UD3 P55 Core i5 LGA1156 Motherboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Having a look at the entry level board from Gigabyte's new P55A line up. No SLI and less robust power delivery are a couple of features missing on this board when compared against its big brother the UD4P.

snippet.title: Gigabyte P55A-UD4P P55 Core i5 SLI motherboard Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Today I have a look at another member of Gigabyte's P55 lineup. The P55A-UD4P. Like its big brother it features SLI, USB 3, and SATA 6Gb/s, but in a more economical package.

snippet.title: Logitech G110 Gaming Keyboard First Look & Unboxing Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: It's been a while since Logitech has been releasing new products so actively. It seems like the G15 gen2 and G9 were on the market forever without a refresh and now suddenly we have TWO new keyboards (G19 and G110) as well as a new mouse (G500) with hopefully more to come!

snippet.title: Noctua NH-C12P SE14 140mm Fan Heatpipe CPU Heatsink Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Having a look at Noctua's brand new CPU cooler. Well, it's not really brand new, but the fan sitting on top of it is quite new. Basically this new cooler is the old NH-C12P, but now it's got a 140mm fan!!

snippet.title: Corsair 8GB 1600MHz C9 DDR3 Dual Channel Memory Kit Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Went down to the warehouse and grabbed a set of Corsair 8GB dual channel "i5" RAM so I thought I'd show you all the packaging it comes in. It lacks the traditional Corsair clamshell on account of it being a 4 DIMM kit. I suspect if these kits take off in popularity we will see more of them in the future, and a proper package. We also have a look at Corsair's hot new heatspreader.

snippet.title: Gigabyte P55-UD5 P55 LGA1156 Core i5 Motherboard Unboxing Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: This step-down board from the uber-premium UD6 that we already looked at is mostly the same in terms of feature set. The biggest differences between the UD5 and the UD6 lie in the subtle details and the inclusion of a 12 phase power design versus a 24 phase power design.

snippet.title: Gigabyte P55M-UD2 P55 LGA1156 Core i5 Motherboard Unboxing Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: It's my pleasure to present Gigabyte entry level P55 motherboard. It's a mATX solution that doesn't have some of the higher end features like sophisticated VRM cooling and SLI/Crossfire, but you can still expect excellent performance out of this small package.

snippet.title: Gigabyte P55-UD6 P55 LGA1156 Core i5 Motherboard Unboxing Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: The cream of the cream for Gigabyte P55 motherboard lineup: The P55-UD6. It features 24 phase power, SLI and Crossfire, and pretty much everything else you could want on a premium board. This is our first video filmed in Taiwan (snicker). I hope you enjoy it.

snippet.title: Gigabyte P55M-UD4 P55 LGA1156 Core i5 Motherboard Unboxing Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Here's the full version of the video I meant to upload last night. I never meant to put up an incomplete video. We cover the accessories and layout of an exciting new P55 motherboard coming from Gigabyte the P55M-UD4. It's the first board we've seen with SLI and Crossfire in a mATX form factor on this new platform.

snippet.title: Picquic Screwdriver Dash 7, Multique, and Teeny Turner Hands On Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: I have a quick look at some "Made Right in Canada" Picquic screwdrivers: The Dash 7, Multique, and Teeny Turner. They feature a unique bit load system and rugged construction.

snippet.title: Lian Li PC-Q07B mITX aluminum PC Case Unboxing Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Well our Lian Li shipment was delayed by the typhoon, but it's finally here! I'm really excited to show off their latest creation. Cool features of this case include support for 1x5.25" drive, 1x3.5" drive, and a standard ATX power supply

snippet.title: MSI P55-GD80 P55 LGA1156 Core i5 Motherboard Unboxing  Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: The last in this series of MSI P55 motherboard unboxing videos (for now...). Stay tuned for more motherboard previews from other vendors as supplies start to trickle in leading up to the launch of the P55 platform.

snippet.title: MSI P55-CD53 P55 LGA1156 Core i5 Motherboard Unboxing Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: I've got the whole MSI P55 family with me now. I'm excited to bring your my unboxing of what I think could be one of the hottest P55 motherboards at launch. MSI is targeting a very aggressive price point with this board, but they're including some killer features like OC Genie and DrMOS.

snippet.title: Gigabyte P55-UD4P P55 LGA1156 Core i5 Motherboard Unboxing Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Just got another P55 sample. From my understanding this board may be an NCIX exclusive at launch in Canada!

snippet.title: Acer Aspire Revo Ion Atom 330 Nettop Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Got my hands on the brand new Acer Aspire Revo. There are finally in stock after so many months of hype about the "upcoming" Ion platform from nVidia. It's finally here! I haven't done any testing with it yet, but

snippet.title: MSI P55-GD65 Base Clock Button Adjustment Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Showing you how the overclocking buttons work on MSI P55-GD65. Very cool feature!

snippet.title: MSI P55-GD65 P55 LGA1156 Core i5 Motherboard Unboxing Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: Unboxing and showing the first P55 sample I've received in the mail. I can't talk about pricing or performance or any of that stuff yet, but it looks very promising!

snippet.title: Intel Bobble Head Pen Holder - The Coolest Swag Ever (Linus Tech Tips Video Blog)
snippet.description: We ask the Intel Bunny Man bobble head what he thinks of AMD's latest Phenom II processors, and we also get his take on the Intel "Extreme" series of processors. We think you will find him to be an unbiased and reliable source of information

snippet.title: nVidia GEFORCE 3D Vision LCD Glasses Unboxing & First Look Linus Tech Tips
snippet.description: I head outside  outside to test out some new glasses, no, not sunglasses, but nVidia's 3D Glasses for use with select 3D monitors

snippet.title: Samsung Digital Photo Frames - SPF-71E, SPF-105P (Linus Tech Tips #6)
snippet.description: We take a look at some new digital photo frames from Samsung which offer a good assortment of feature and excellent picture quality.

snippet.title: Personal Grooming with a USB Shaver (Linus Tech Tips #5)
snippet.description: I was rather rushed this evening, and had forgotten to shave in quite some time. Luckily the world of USB power products never ceases to amaze and came to my rescue!

snippet.title: Lenovo Ideapad S10 Netbook Unboxing and Overview
snippet.description: I decide to crack open the latest netbook from Lenovo, the Ideapad S10. While it may not feature the same bells and whistles as other subnotes on the market - it sure is fabulous!

snippet.title: eVGA X58 Motherboard Overview (Linus Tech Tips #3)
snippet.description: I take a look at the highly anticipated eVGA x58 motherboard, eVGA's first NON nVidia chipset based offering.

snippet.title: Asus Rampage 2 Extreme Motherboard (Linus Tech Tips #2)
snippet.description: I take a quick peek at the top end X58 motherboard from Asus, the Rampage 2 Extreme, and explore a few of the features.

snippet.title: Undisclosed AMD Processor at 3.6GHz (Linus Tech Tips #1)
snippet.description: I confirm my results of overclocking a secret AMD processor to 3.6GHz
